description: Unit test class for JsonObjectValueValidator, verifying validation and immutability behavior for JSON object validation in header definitions.

classes.name: JsonObjectValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for JsonObjectValueValidator, a class responsible for validating JSON object values within header definitions.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes a valid JSON object string used in multiple test cases.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null as the definition parameter throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that passing null as the value parameter throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException with a message indicating the value is invalid.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that a valid JSON object string is accepted without exceptions.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotJsonObject
methods.description: Checks that a valid JSON string does not throw an exception even if the associated header definition expects a different type.

methods.name: acceptNonJsonObjectString
methods.description: Tests that an invalid JSON object string triggers a DittoHeaderInvalidException.
